svg.title: Sheep
svg.desc: Standing domestic sheep with dense off-white fleece, narrow face, lateral ears, long limbs, and cloven hooves. Biological basis: Sheep provide a large-animal scale for cardiovascular, pulmonary, reproductive, fetal, orthopedic, and surgical research.
